email.subject1: a signal play for Zus Health
email.body1:
Ty, Zus Health's aggregated profile now reaches across 70,000 provider sites and over 270 million patients.

Reach like that usually means more health systems and digital health buyers evaluating you than reps can cover, and that is where enterprise deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Zus Health off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ty, quick follow-up for Zus Health.

In enterprise healthcare, pipeline targets rarely soften, but most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Zus Health needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ty, last bit of proof for Zus Health.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Zus Health's reply rate likely compares to other digital health teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Ty, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and I know long healthcare cycles keep you busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise health motion? I will tailor it to Zus Health either way.
